text.formatted: The nightmare can grant resistance to fire damage to anyone riding it.
text.plain: The nightmare can grant resistance to fire damage to anyone riding it.

text.formatted: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10 foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.
text.plain: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10 foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

text.formatted: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it magically enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.
text.plain: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it magically enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.
